findings.description: Use of unwrap() on a fallible operation can panic the program.
findings.impact: Unexpected program crashes or denial of service.

findings.description: Missing check to prevent re-initializing an already initialized account.
findings.impact: Attackers can reset account state, overwriting balances or owner data.

findings.description: Arithmetic operation performed without checked math.
findings.impact: Underflow/Overflow can lead to logic bypass, such as infinite token printing.
